why_it_fails: Three separate decisions (the price, the email company, the logo) are asked as one yes/no question, so a press cannot say which of them the person agreed to, and nothing says what each change costs or risks.

card.title: Pricing, email and logo
card.context: A few things came up this week. We could raise the monthly price for new clinics, move our emails to a different email company, and switch to the new logo the designer sent.
card.question: Should we raise the price for new clinics, move to the new email company and switch to the new logo?
card.why: Better to do it all at once.
